integrity: The proof derives the global inequality and matches it with a boundary-median sequence. Symbolic and numerical checks are corroborative, and no claim of independent certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Only the continuous-time symmetric three-type operator on the closed simplex and Euclidean distance; no extension to general parameter families. Exact supremum rather than finite-pair maximum. The 2026 follow-up full text was not accessible; independent priority confirmation remains open.
title: Sharp time-dependent contraction of a three-species non-Volterra quadratic flow
